title: Super cute bedset
text: Super cute bedset. This is super lightweight. so far the fading hasn't been too bad I've had to wash it at least three times. Absolutely love the print. However when I did purchase it I ran it through the wash and then I put it directly on my kids nursery bed, and I collapsed on to it and I felt something stabbed me, there was a piece of wire embedded or sewn into the fabric.. it did cut me and draw blood. From what I've gathered I searched the rest of the blanket that was the only piece I could find and I did remove it. Aside from that weird flaw which I  warn you to check for just in case, it's amazing
